summary: Abbott said Wednesday it plans to spin out its nutrition business into an independent, publicly traded company. The business has approximately $8.5 billion in annual sales and includes brands like Pedialyte, Similac and Ensure. In Abbott’s third quarter, nutrition brought in revenue of $2.26 billion, representing year-over-year growth of about 5%. Abbott’s nutrition business has been at the center of lawsuits as well as a federal investigation into the manufacturing and handling of a recall of powdered infant formula in 2022 due to potential contamination. In September, the company announced a $385 million settlement with the Department of Justice to resolve claims as well as lawsuits filed by certain relators and the attorneys general in several states.
